response.sql:
WITH qualifying_films AS (
  SELECT film_id, rating, rental_rate, rental_duration
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost <= 20.99
),
per_film_ratios AS (
  SELECT rating, rental_rate / rental_duration AS ratio
  FROM qualifying_films
),
per_rating_avg AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM per_film_ratios
  GROUP BY rating
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio
  FROM per_rating_avg
)
SELECT 
  pra.rating,
  pra.avg_ratio,
  pra.avg_ratio - om.mean_ratio AS difference_above_mean
FROM per_rating_avg pra
CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
WHERE pra.avg_ratio > om.mean_ratio
ORDER BY pra.rating;

assumptions.assumption: The replacement_cost cutoff is interpreted as an upper bound: films with replacement_cost ≤ 20.99 are qualifying. The alternative is replacement_cost ≥ 20.99 (lower bound).

alternatives.interpretation: Films with replacement_cost ≥ 20.99 (at or above the cutoff) as the qualifying set
